systems.tiers: collectivités territoriales and sector ministries; a decree in the Journal officiel of 31 July 2026 gives a state body, not named in the passages, the task of supporting their setting up

note: Journal officiel of 31 July 2026, passages only; the collectivités territoriales appear in citations of laws, an allowances table and the missions of a territorial planning body, one of which is to support geographic information systems at their level. A legal mandate with no deployment stated, and nothing on the connection of local government offices.
